per_instance.R.01:Contact: A customer or supplier the business invoices or is billed by.
per_instance.R.01:Invoice: Money owed TO the business by a customer.

R.15:Invoice.name: Send
R.15:Invoice.effect: emails the invoice document to the Contact and stamps the sent time

per_instance.R.01:Invoice line: One charged item on an invoice.
per_instance.R.01:Bill: Money owed BY the business to a supplier.
per_instance.R.01:Payment: A received or made payment applied against an invoice or bill.

FL.03:Invoice lifecycle.event: Payments applied to the invoice reach its total

per_instance.FL.08:Invoice lifecycle: Paid invoices lock permanently and feed Profit & loss; Voided invoices keep their number and show struck through.

FL.03:Bill lifecycle.event: Payments applied to the bill reach its total

per_instance.FL.08:Bill lifecycle: Paid bills lock and feed Profit & loss as expenses.

N.01:Invoice sent.event: the Send action runs on an invoice

N.02:Invoice sent.who: the invoice's Contact, at their email address

per_instance.N.04:Invoice sent: Here is your invoice: what it's for, the total, the due date and how to pay.

N.02:Payment reminder.who: the invoice's Contact — only while the invoice is in Awaiting payment

per_instance.N.04:Payment reminder: This invoice is past due — pay it or tell us why not.
per_instance.N.04:Payment received: An invoice just got paid in full.
per_instance.RP.01:Profit and loss: What did the business earn and spend in the period?
per_instance.RP.01:Aged receivables: Who owes us money, and how overdue is it?
RP.04:Aged receivables: overdue invoice totals bucketed by age
per_instance.RP.05:Profit and loss:revenue: sum of (Quantity x Unit amount) over Invoice lines whose Invoice is in Awaiting payment or Paid (never Draft or Voided), attributed to the Invoice's Issue date — accrual basis, GST-exclusive
per_instance.RP.05:Profit and loss:expenses: sum of Bill Amount for Bills in Awaiting payment or Paid, attributed to the Bill's Issue date — accrual basis
per_instance.RP.05:Profit and loss:net profit: revenue minus expenses, exactly as those two are defined above
per_instance.RP.05:Aged receivables:overdue invoice t: for each Invoice in Awaiting payment: its total minus applied Payments, bucketed by days past Due date as at today (current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+)
per_instance.P.01:Accountant: Does the books: raises invoices, records bills and payments.
per_instance.P.01:Advisor: An external accountant/bookkeeper with read-only access to everything financial.
